summary: Fresh end-to-end validation of the Stripe (direct, RevenueCat-removed) subscription flow for Wisdom & Word. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass — health reports payments_configured=true, POST /api/payments/checkout returns cs_test_ session id and https://checkout.stripe.com/ URL, payment status is 'unpaid' before payment, subscription status for unknown user returns pro_active=false with echoed app_user_id, restore returns found=false for unknown email, restore with invalid email returns 422, and verse-of-day still works. Frontend: paywall renders with $4.99/month card, optional checkout-email-input, Subscribe button, and 'Secure checkout by Stripe · Test card 4242 4242 4242 4242' line. Clicking Subscribe successfully redirects the browser to https://checkout.stripe.com/... (verified via framenavigated + request logs and screenshot of Stripe skeleton). /payment/success?session_id=cs_test_fake_id shows payment-success-page with 'Almost there.' heading + message + Continue button that returns to /. /payment/cancel shows 'Checkout cancelled.' + back button. Restore flow: invalid email surfaces validation toast; unknown email surfaces 'No subscription was found for this email' toast. Regression: fresh ask flow generates counsel + scripture cards (Claude) with Listen/Share/Download buttons; verse-of-day loads; access-pill-free visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~560 lines — still manageable but approaching the recommended split threshold; consider extracting payments/subscription routes into a sub-router for maintainability.
subscription.js pollPaymentStatus swallows non-404 errors silently; a max total timeout warning to the user would improve UX on the /payment/success page for network flakiness.
test_credentials: None required — Stripe Emergent-managed sandbox uses backend key.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage 'wisdom_free_counsel_count'=3 used only in-browser to force paywall.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RevenueCat has been fully removed and replaced with direct Stripe (test mode). The relevant regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_flow.py (pytest). Paywall data-testids: paywall-modal, paywall-subscribe, checkout-email-input, paywall-restore-link, restore-email-input, restore-submit. Payment pages: payment-success-page/-message/-continue and payment-cancel-page/-continue. When verifying Stripe redirect, listen to page.on('framenavigated') because expect_response body may become unreadable once the page cross-navigates to checkout.stripe.com.
